### Daniel is Taken to Babylon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/daniel-taken-babylon
Passage: Daniel 1:1-7
Points:
- Daniel’s prophetic service commenced following his capture and exile to Babylon in 605 BC.
- Jerusalem’s capture did not indicate weakness in the Lord, but His discipline upon Judah.
- Nebuchadnezzar succeeded only because God delivered the king and temple vessels into his hand.
- The sovereign Lord directs all of history and determines the rise and fall of kingdoms.
- God eternally ordains every circumstance to advance His glory and work for believers' good.
